items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: There were two brothers... One was Frank... and of course Jess, my cousin played the guitar along with them.

ctx.x: Do you have any more recollections of the Red Hot Peppers and who the other members were besides your uncle?
